newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk court clears Islamist mayor rebel charge.
newsitem.headline: Turk court clears Islamist mayor rebel charge.

text.p: A Turkish security court on Monday acquitted a mayor from the ruling Islamist Welfare Party on a charge of aiding Kurdish rebels, court officials said.
Behrun Aygoren, mayor of the southeastern town of Dicle was arrested and charged early in March by the court in the city of Diyarbakir.
He was elected as an independent candidate at local polls in 1994 but later joined Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's Welfare Party.
Guerrillas from the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) have been fighting Turkish security forces in the region since 1984. More than 21,000 people have been killed in the conflict.
